# CelesteOS

> CelesteOS is the planned maintenance system (PMS) for private and charter superyachts of 30 metres and above. It keeps a vessel's manuals, work orders, faults, equipment, parts, certificates and handover records in one searchable record that stays with the vessel when the crew rotates. It is built by CelesteOS LLC.

Key facts:

- Category: engineering and maintenance software for superyachts. It is a planned maintenance system, web-based.
- Who uses it: chief engineers (the primary users), ETOs, captains and shore-based fleet technical managers.
- Handover: the engineering handover assembles from work as it is logged. Every line links back to its live record, and the outgoing and incoming engineers sign and acknowledge it.
- Ledger: every record carries an append-only audit trail showing who did what and when, with before and after values. Corrections reference the original, and nothing is overwritten. Records are sealed, can be exported as a structured PDF, and can be verified without an account.
- Search: plain-language search across manuals, faults, work orders, parts and history. Every answer cites its source.
- Certificates: flag, class and statutory certificates are tracked to expiry, with alerts at 30, 14 and 7 days and the source PDF attached.
- Onboarding: existing manuals, PDFs, scans and exports are indexed as they are, with no reformatting. The equipment register, certificates and work-order history are imported for the vessel.
- Compliance: aligned with ISM Code sections 10 and 11. CelesteOS is audit evidence, not class approval. It does not hold DNV, LR, BV or ABS Type Approval.
- Pricing: the pilot is USD 995 per vessel per month. Pricing is per vessel, not per user, with unlimited seats and no per-module tiering. The pilot rate is locked for 12 months from go-live, and each pilot runs on three to five vessels.
- Founder: Alex Short, formerly an Electro-Technical Officer and then Head of Department on motor yachts from 70 to 125 metres.
